visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins in a brightly lit kitchen. A person's hands are seen placing raw, cut pork ribs into a stainless steel bowl filled with water. The hands gently stir and soak the meat. In the background, a modern kitchen setup with a black stovetop and various small condiment bowls on a wooden tray is visible. (2) The focus shifts to food preparation as the hands mix the ribs with seasonings, including garlic paste and a brown powder. The ribs are then dredged in white flour. The scene transitions to a deep-frying process where several pieces of garlic and then the flour-coated ribs are placed into a black pot filled with hot oil, causing vigorous bubbling. (3) The person is seen peeling a large white radish and a carrot with a black peeler. They then use a sharp knife to cut the radishes into triangular chunks on a light-colored wooden cutting board. The fried ribs and the cut radishes are then layered into a white ceramic pot with a floral pattern, followed by the addition of a clear liquid broth and water. (4) The woman, wearing a pink apron over a white shirt, is shown tasting the final soup from a white bowl. She holds a wooden spoon, takes a sip, and smiles broadly at the camera while making a peace sign. The background remains the clean, well-lit kitchen, and the video concludes with her finishing the soup and showing the empty bowl.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 排骨先洗乾淨 泡溫水15分鐘. (2) [Subtitle]: 泡到血水滲出. [Subtitle]: 取出擦乾水分 避免影響醃漬的調味. (3) [Subtitle]: 準備醃漬材料： 一撮的鹽 5克糖 一小白胡椒粉 5克五香粉 蒜泥 12克 兩顆蛋黃 20ml的紹興酒 15ml 醬油. [Subtitle]: 所有食材比例請看留言板. (4) [Subtitle]: 充分的搓揉均勻. [Subtitle]: 放入保鮮盒中，醃漬6小時 或者一個晚上. (5) [Subtitle]: 醃漬好之後，先放到退冰一下下. [Subtitle]: 盆裡倒入地瓜粉. (6) [Subtitle]: 把排骨均勻的裹上一圈地瓜粉. [Subtitle]: 接著放一旁等反潮再來炸. (7) [Subtitle]: 起一鍋油 或半煎炸方式. [Subtitle]: 油溫溫的時候 先放入蒜頭炸香. (8) [Subtitle]: 大約炸到140度. [Subtitle]: 蒜頭有一點焦香 就先取出... (9) [Subtitle]: 繼續拉高油溫到170~180度. [Subtitle]: 放入排骨進來炸. (10) [Subtitle]: 排骨大約炸3~5分鐘左右. [Subtitle]: 直到表面金黃酥脆. (11) [Subtitle]: 中途撈掉渣渣 繼續再炸第二輪. [Subtitle]: 同樣維持170度 再下鍋炸排骨. (12) [Subtitle]: 炸好取出來.. 一旁瀝油... [Subtitle]: 紅、白蘿蔔先刨皮. (13) [Subtitle]: 去掉頭尾 切成四等份 再滾刀切成塊... [Subtitle]: 紅蘿蔔滾刀切. (14) [Subtitle]: 材料超級簡單： 300克的炸排骨 500克的白蘿蔔 150克的紅蘿蔔 炸蒜頭.... [Subtitle]: 白蘿蔔放入鍋. (15) [Subtitle]: 炸排骨... 紅蘿蔔 炸蒜頭. [Subtitle]: 自製的雞骨蔬菜高湯（作法請看上一集）. (16) [Subtitle]: 補500~600ml的水. [Subtitle]: 開中火加熱. (17) [Subtitle]: 來一小撮鹽 跟一點酒 調味. [Subtitle]: 快滾的時候 撈掉上面的浮沫. (18) [Subtitle]: 滾了轉小火，蓋上鍋蓋燉煮30分鐘左右. [Subtitle]: 熄火之後再悶10分鐘. (19) [Subtitle]: 好囉~開蓋~ 哇！好香的味道❤️ [Subtitle]: 撈掉上面的油 湯會更清爽！. (20) [Subtitle]: 像這樣，超級好喝的排骨酥蘿蔔湯 就完成啦~❤️ [Subtitle]: 加了高湯的湯頭 喝起來 非常有層次❤️. (21) [Subtitle]: 排骨軟了，蘿蔔入味了❤️ [Subtitle]: 懶得自己炸排骨的朋友 也可以買現成的. (22) [Subtitle]: 最後灑上香菜末 整個香氣就更棒了！❤️ [Subtitle]: 排骨酥蘿蔔湯～❤️. (23) [Subtitle]: 來一點白胡椒～❤️ [Subtitle]: 哇！好深奧的味道～❤️. (24) [Subtitle]: 第一次做就大成功！❤️ [Subtitle]: 好喝到兒鍋底啦. (25) [Slogan]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, mid-tempo acoustic guitar melody accompanied by soft piano notes. A gentle water splashing sound is heard as the ribs are soaked. The music maintains a cheerful, major-key tonality. (2) A sharp sizzling sound enters the mix as meat hits hot oil, accompanied by the percussive bubbles of deep-frying. The BGM remains steady in the background. (3) Rhythmic, percussive thuds of a knife hitting a wooden cutting board are clearly audible, following the tempo of the music. The spectral brightness increases during these transient events. (4) A mechanical click is heard when the stove is turned on, followed by a metallic lid clink. Towards the end, a high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice expresses enjoyment with phrases like 'Wah!', featuring rising intonation and high arousal. The BGM fades out softly with the voice.
